summary: Serve the Canonical Intake and record its result as it is reasoned.

commands.summary: Resume the intake being recorded, or start a fresh one. If the active metaform already has an intake, creates a separate intake-<UTC timestamp> metaform, keeping the earlier one untouched. Says its name, and hands you the Canonical Intake to follow; the existing web GUI follows it live.
